strings.Включи известията — ще ти напомняме кога: Turn on notifications — we'll remind you when your next meal is and what it is.
strings.На Android: разреши известията и изключи: On Android: allow notifications and turn off battery optimization for Eatologix. On iPhone: add the site to your Home Screen from Safari.
strings.консултант, който знае плана ти: an advisor who knows your plan
strings.От закуската до вечерята — с грамажи, ка: From breakfast to dinner — with portions, calories and macros. Swap a meal and the day's balance is recalculated.
strings.Отговорите тръгват от твоя план и профил: Answers start from your plan and profile, not from generic advice.
strings.Да — скумрия, 160 г. Протеинът за деня о: Yes — mackerel, 160 g. Your protein for the day stays the same.
strings.Снимка на ястие или на менюто в ресторан: A photo of a dish or a restaurant menu — and you know what fits your goals.
strings.Поискай корекция. Виждаш какво се промен: Ask for an adjustment. You see what changes and why before it's applied.
strings.Препоръки, проверени за взаимодействия,: Recommendations checked for interactions, and activity matched to your plan.
strings.Хранене, медицина, спорт и психология. А: Nutrition, medicine, sport and psychology. The algorithm proposes — a human checks.
strings.Въпросник за здраве, навици, цели и люби: A questionnaire about your health, habits, goals and favorite foods.
strings.Енергия, белтък и ограничения по здравет: Energy, protein and health-based restrictions — calculated, not guessed. A specialist reviews the result.
strings.Планът е в приложението — с напомняния,: Your plan lives in the app — with reminders, swaps and an advisor.
strings.Всяка седмица няколко въпроса — тегло, г: A few questions every week — weight, hunger, energy. The menu is refreshed and calories are adjusted when your results call for it.
Write to us. We read every message.
strings.С известия за храненията и старт с едно: With meal notifications and one-tap launch. Android and iPhone.
strings.От Safari — на началния екран като прило: From Safari — on your Home Screen like an app.
Nutrition guidance, not a medical service. If you have a medical condition, consult your doctor.
strings.Добави приложението към началния екран: Add the app to your Home Screen
strings.Добави на екрана за бърз достъп и извест: Add it to your Home Screen for quick access and notifications
strings.Нямаш профил? Попълни въпросника: No account yet? Fill in the questionnaire
strings.Какво искаш да ни кажеш?: What would you like to tell us?
strings.Eatologix — логиката на твоето хранене: Eatologix — the logic of your eating
strings.Хранителен план, изчислен от над 30 твои: A nutrition plan calculated from 30+ of your markers, checked by a specialist and recalculated every week. You eat and see the results — the logic is ours.
strings.Всяко ястие, грамаж и замяна следват от: Every meal, portion and swap follows from your data. When something changes — your weight, schedule or appetite — the numbers are redone.
The questionnaire takes a few minutes.
The logic is ours. The results are yours.
strings.Хранителен план с точни грамажи, изчисле: A nutrition plan with exact portions, calculated for your body, health and goal, and recalculated every week.
strings.Общите съвети за хранене са за всички —: General nutrition advice is for everyone — which means it's for no one. We calculate your logical choice: what, how much and when to eat, based on your body, health and goal. The logic is ours, the results are yours.
strings.Какво ядеш, защо го ядеш,: What you eat, why you eat it,
strings.Откъде идва гладът, който не е глад. Рез: Where hunger that isn't hunger comes from. The results go straight into your plan.
strings.Анализ по снимка на ириса. Находките вли: Analysis from a photo of your iris. The findings feed into your plan as additional data.
strings.Инсулинова резистентност, автоимунни със: Insulin resistance, autoimmune conditions, menopause, anti-aging and more — 11 protocols.
